templates.text: Sudden limb extension → immediate flexion at the joint, followed by a brief, rhythmic tremor.
Passive rotation of the head to one side → the ipsilateral arm extends, the contralateral leg flexes.
Gentle pressure on the sole of the foot → toes fan outward, then curl inward in a slow, deliberate grasp.
A light, sustained touch to the palm → fingers close in a palmar grasp, held for {seconds} seconds before release.
Sudden loss of head support → the arms jerk outward in a symmetrical embrace, then slowly recoil.
A firm stroke along the lateral foot → the big toe dorsiflexes while the other toes splay and abduct.
Brief, moderate pressure on the abdomen → the pelvis tilts upward, followed by a lateral trunk curl.
Light touch to the cheek → the head turns toward the stimulus, mouth opens in a rooting motion.
Sudden, gentle jostle of the bassinet → both legs draw up toward the torso in a protective tuck.
Passive flexion of the knee → the hip automatically flexes, creating a coordinated fetal posture.
A sustained, moderate pull on the hands → the infant resists, engaging shoulder and neck muscles to pull back.
Cool air currents across the face → a brief breath-hold, then a sharp, gasping inhalation through the nose.
Tactile stimulus to the corner of the mouth → the tongue protrudes and laterally sweeps the area.
Sudden elevation of the feet above the head → the arms extend forward in a protective reaching motion.
A rolling motion onto the side → the uppermost arm extends, the lower arm flexes across the chest.
Deep, steady pressure on the ball of the foot → the leg stiffens and pushes against the pressure source.
A light tap below the kneecap → a brisk, localized kick of the lower leg, then rapid relaxation.
Sudden tilting of the body forward → the arms extend and hands splay in a parachute-like response.
Gentle, rhythmic stroking of the spine → the back arches slightly, then settles into a relaxed curve.
A firm touch to the sole during stepping reflex → the leg lifts and executes a deliberate, high-step motion.
Sudden release of supported sitting → the head rights itself with a jerky, corrective neck extension.
Moderate pressure on both shoulders → the head tucks downward, chin meeting the sternum.
A slow, passive stretch of the arm overhead → the body follows with a gradual, whole-trunk side bend.
Brief constriction around the chest → the abdomen expands with a deep diaphragmatic breath.
Light stroking from heel to toe → the foot plantarflexes, pushing against the direction of the stroke.
Sudden noise coinciding with a sway → the Moro reflex initiates but is dampened to a brief startle shudder.
Sustained touch to the lateral thigh → the leg adducts, drawing inward toward the body's midline.
A gentle upward lift under the arms → the legs perform a slow, alternating stepping motion.
Passive extension of the wrist → the fingers reflexively extend and then slowly curl back to a neutral position.
A sudden, localized chill on the skin → a quick, shivering tremor isolated to the affected limb segment.
